title: Post-Theodosian Novels (Novellae of Theodosius II, Valentinian III, Marcian, Majorian, Severus, Anthemius) / RU: «Новеллы» после Кодекса Феодосия (RU-gap)
author: Imperial chanceries
size: c. 85 laws; est. 35–40k words; Majorian's Novels c. 12 laws
edition: Mommsen & Meyer, Theodosiani libri XVI, vol. II (1905), public domain: https://archive.org/details/theodosianilibri00codeuoft
ru_evidence: Only selections: Novels of Theodosius II translated by E. V. Silvestrova (История Древнего Рима. Тексты и документы, 2005, pp. 231–232). A full annotated translation of the Codex Theodosianus remains unpublished (ru.wikipedia).
en_evidence: Pharr, The Theodosian Code and Novels and the Sirmondian Constitutions (1952; Open Library).
value: The last legislation of the Western Empire: taxation, city councillors (curiales), barbarian settlement, urban decline, Majorian's reforms. Essential for 5th-c. social and economic history.
ai_feasibility: high: formulaic legal Latin; Pharr allows verification. The institutional commentary is the demanding part.
pilot_unit: Novellae Maioriani (458–460; c. 12 laws; est. 8k words)
